messages:
elaine: Kicking off a larger SDK docs reorg today. I'm splitting changes across 4 PRs to reduce preview churn: #501 core content, #502 path moves, #503 redirects/anchor-mappings, #504 examples/snippets. Need explicit merge order and short smoke checks. @sam can you coordinate merges?

sam: Proposed sequence: 1) #501 (core) -> 2) #503 (redirects/anchors) -> 3) #502 (path moves) -> 4) #504 (snippets). Redirects must be live before path moves to prevent 404s in previews; examples last. I'll reserve a 90m merge window tomorrow.

mike: I'll add a small script to #503 that emits both path-level redirects and broken-anchor mappings. It writes `anchor-redirects.yml`. The script also logs a dry-run so we can inspect diffs without applying.

frank: Heads-up about search indexing: when many paths change the indexer sometimes crashes on duplicate slugs. Plan to run targeted indexer run after #501 and again after #502. Use `./tools/reindex --paths docs/sdk --dry-run` first.

ci-bot: PR #501 preview: https://preview.internal.redwood/pr/501  Build: success, warnings: frontmatter title length on /sdk/advanced/long-usage.md

jen: Can we scope the redirects to only the moved pages for two weeks and then peel them? Temporary mapping reduces long-term maintenance.

sam: Agreed. Add an expiry comment in `anchor-redirects.yml` (TTL: 14d). Also, gating checklist: approvals on #501 + green preview, run docs-lint, run dry-run reindex, merge #501, run targeted reindex, merge #503, wait 10m for CDN sync, merge #502, reindex, then merge #504.

elaine: I'll add DO NOT MERGE notes on #502 and #504 until prior PRs are live. Also adding a pre-merge linter step: `make docs-lint` + `scripts/check-frontmatter-length.py`.

mike: Script posted to #503 branch. Includes a mode `--emit-to-stdout` for review. Example output attached in PR description.

frank: Reminder: our preview CDN sometimes shows stale redirects for ~5-20 minutes. Sam's wait windows should be at least 15 minutes.

sam: Merge window scheduled: 2026-03-23 16:30 UTC. I'll post a 30m reminder and coordinate live merges. Please do not merge outside the window. I'll also prepare rollback steps in release-war-room.

jen: I'll approve #501 after verifying the preview and linter. Ping when the reindex is done.

ci-bot: Lint results for #501: 3 warnings (frontmatter length), 0 errors.

elaine: Trimmed a couple long titles and pushed fix to #501. Re-running preview.

mike: For anchor mapping, note that old headings like "Quick start: auth flows" were converted to `quick-start-auth-flows` and now map to `/sdk/authentication.md#quick-start-auth-flows`. I added examples to the mapping file.

frank: If the indexer fails post-merge, run: `./tools/reindex --paths docs/sdk --staging --retry 5` and ping me. Also monitor cloudwatch for 500s on /search endpoints.

sam: I'll coordinate merges and post a short live timeline in this thread during the window. Also setting a brief smoke test after each merge: curl the key moved pages and check 200 + expected HTML title. e.g. `curl -sI https://preview.internal.redwood/docs/sdk/authentication | grep HTTP`

elaine: Added smoke curl commands in PR checklists and noted the TTL for redirects. Thanks team!"
